description: Source code for managing cache rankings in Chromium's disk cache, including classes and functions for linked list operations, crash simulation, and transaction management.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Manages crash-safe transactions for cache list modifications.

classes.name: Rankings
classes.description: Handles cache ranking list operations, including insertion, removal, validation, and iteration.

classes.name: CacheRankingsBlock
classes.description: Represents a node in the cache rankings linked list.

classes.name: ScopedRankingsBlock
classes.description: Smart pointer for managing CacheRankingsBlock instances.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Iterates over cache ranking list nodes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Rankings object with backend and configuration.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node into the ranking list.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from the ranking list.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next node in the list.

methods.name: GetPrev
methods.description: Retrieves the previous node in the list.

methods.name: CheckList
methods.description: Validates the integrity of a list.

methods.name: SanityCheck
methods.description: Performs sanity checks on a node.

methods.name: DataSanityCheck
methods.description: Checks data validity of a node.

methods.name: SetContents
methods.description: Sets the contents address of a node.

methods.name: ReadHeads
methods.description: Reads head pointers from control data.

methods.name: ReadTails
methods.description: Reads tail pointers from control data.

methods.name: WriteHead
methods.description: Writes head pointer for a list.

methods.name: WriteTail
methods.description: Writes tail pointer for a list.

methods.name: GetRanking
methods.description: Loads and validates a ranking node.

methods.name: ConvertToLongLived
methods.description: Converts a node to a long-lived copy.

methods.name: CompleteTransaction
methods.description: Completes a crash recovery transaction.

methods.name: FinishInsert
methods.description: Finalizes an insert operation after crash recovery.

methods.name: RevertRemove
methods.description: Reverts a removal operation after crash recovery.

methods.name: CheckLinks
methods.description: Validates link consistency between nodes.

methods.name: CheckSingleLink
methods.description: Checks link consistency between two nodes.

methods.name: UpdateTimes
methods.description: Updates last used and modified timestamps.

methods.name: UpdateIterators
methods.description: Synchronizes iterators pointing to a node.

methods.name: UpdateIteratorsForRemoved
methods.description: Updates iterators after node removal.

methods.name: IncrementCounter
methods.description: Increments list size counter.

methods.name: DecrementCounter
methods.description: Decrements list size counter.
